thread:
mia_sales: Customer wants a 2-week POC with strict country-lock: Ireland (EU) + Singapore only. Need subprocessor list, routing order, and proof we can refuse cross-border failover. Also asked about pricing delta for regional pin.

josh_solutions: We can enable a "country-lock" header for the POC: requests with X-Redwood-Country: IE or SG. If target region down and country-lock=true we will reject rather than failover.

josh_solutions: Sample curl:
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $T' -H 'X-Redwood-Country: IE' -H 'X-Redwood-Country-Lock: true' -d '{"model":"redwood-14b","input":"..."}'

tariq_sre: Ops note: Hosted control-plane metadata may cross borders; for zero control-plane egress use Dedicated or Private. For POC we can mask telemetry and produce pcaps showing no egress.

anna_legal: I'll export the subprocessor CSV and draft a one-page attestation for the POC. Production EU-only commitment requires DPA addendum and BYOK onboarding.

tiles_bot: Ticket POC-7782 created, runbook workspace: https://internal.redwood/presales/POC-7782 assigned @tariq_sre @josh_solutions.

mia_sales: Can team deliver CSV + attestation + ballpark uplift by EOD tomorrow?

josh_solutions: Yes — one-pager + uplift note (~+25% for Dedicated regional pin, BYOK PS fees separate) will be ready.
